title: BillingWebhookEvent
description: Inbound Stripe webhook event the system will eventually consume (spec/contract only: no charge path, no Stripe SDK, no network calls in this parcel). Idempotency semantics: eventId is globally unique; consumers must deduplicate on eventId and a replayed event must not double-apply any entitlement transition.

eventId.description: Stripe event id (evt_...). Unique idempotency key: the consumer must record processed eventIds and ignore replays so no entitlement transition is applied twice.

type.description: Stripe event type. Unknown types must be rejected, never applied.

created.description: Event creation timestamp in UTC (ISO-8601). Used for ordering/staleness checks; replayed stale events must not regress newer entitlement state.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key mapped from the Stripe object (e.g. subscription/charge metadata or client_reference_id). Entitlements are always evaluated for this tenantId.

data.description: Minimal event payload (status hints, amounts, period ends). Free-form: consumers read only the fields they need and must tolerate unknown fields.
